data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Elysium was the name of the paradise for heroes, while Helios was the god of the sun. Elyse, as a derivative of Helios, symbolizes the radiance and light of the divine sun. In the New Testament, Elyse is a variant of Elisabeth, meaning 'God is my oath' or 'My God is an oath.'
